existing.eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens who are currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree programme, or who will hold a bachelor's degree by the award start date and do not hold a PhD. Candidates apply through their campus Fulbright Program Adviser. Award categories include Study/Research, English Teaching Assistant, Fulbright-National Geographic and Fulbright-Fogarty awards.
benefits: Stipend based on host-country cost of living for room, board and incidental costs
12 months of non-competitive eligibility hiring status within the federal government
Round-trip transportation for grants to Post countries
Pre-departure and/or in-country orientations for Post countries
coverage: Stipend broadly based on the cost of living in the host country, usable for room, board and incidental costs
Round-trip transportation to the host country for grants to Post countries
Based on award and country, possible book and research allowances, mid-term enrichment activities, full or partial tuition, and language study programmes
requirements: Application submitted through the campus Fulbright Program Adviser
Meet the national deadline of 5 pm Eastern Time on 6 October 2026
Choose an award type and host country
application_method: Find the Fulbright Program Adviser on your campus
Complete the online application with the adviser
existing.selection_notes: Final selections are approved by the J. William Fulbright Foreign Scholarship Board; notification is on a rolling basis.
existing.best_fit: U.S. citizens enrolled in a degree programme, or recent graduates without a PhD, who want to study, research or teach English abroad.
existing.notes: Grant numbers are subject to federally appropriated funds and the U.S. Department of State reserves the right to alter participating countries, award numbers, terms and allowances.
existing.duration: One academic year or more of study, research or teaching abroad, as specified in the award description
existing.application_period: 2027-2028 award cycle, applications open now; institutional deadlines may be earlier
existing.deadline_display: National Deadline: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 at 5 pm Eastern Time for the 2027-2028 award cycle
